e53fa38febd8ce582e666b8723c67d6b.overview: Fifth Avenue socialite Irene Bullock needs a "forgotten man" to win a scavenger hunt, and no one is more forgotten than Godfrey Park, who resides in a dump by the East River. Irene hires Godfrey as a servant for her riotously unhinged family, to the chagrin of her spoiled sister, Cornelia, who tries her best to get Godfrey fired. As Irene falls for her new butler, Godfrey turns the tables and teaches the frivolous Bullocks a lesson or two.
e53fa38febd8ce582e666b8723c67d6b.tagline: Butler! FOR THE COCK-EYEDEST FAMILY in the WHOLE WORLD!...and the butler-blonde battle was on!

e54f3dba1c53291c31009860f54ea59c.overview: Mortimer Brewster, a newspaper drama critic, playwright, and author known for his diatribes against marriage, suddenly falls in love and gets married;  but when he makes a quick trip home to tell his two maiden aunts, he finds out his aunts' hobby - killing lonely old men and burying them in the cellar!
e54f3dba1c53291c31009860f54ea59c.tagline: She Passed Out On Cary! No Wonder . . . She's just discovered his favorite aunts have poisoned their 13th gentleman friend!

e55a0eb26297d8c63559bc06a5464575.overview: A significantly deformed but highly intelligent teenage boy and his biker gang mother attempt to live as normal a life as possible under the circumstances.
e55a0eb26297d8c63559bc06a5464575.tagline: They told 16 year old Rocky Dennis he could never be like everyone else. So he was determined to be better.

e5936d8d33cfb5d89a0feeec7be75504.overview: An average family is thrust into the spotlight after the father commits a seemingly self-defense murder at his diner.
e5936d8d33cfb5d89a0feeec7be75504.tagline: Tom Stall had the perfect life...until he became a hero.

e5955c2dcf3d14f8c08163ff1f4ab735.overview: Black police officer Russell Stevens applies for a special anti-drug squad which targets the highest boss of cocaine delivery to LA—the Colombian foreign minister's nephew. Russell works his way up from the bottom undercover, until he reaches the boss.
e5955c2dcf3d14f8c08163ff1f4ab735.tagline: There's a thin line between catching a criminal... and becoming one.

e5bf3894bc5a04e0efffd05422016483.overview: Jack Flowers is an American hustler trying to make his fortune in 1970s Singapore in small time pimping. His dreams of building a fortune by running a brothel himself and returning to the States is materialized when he is offered the opportunity by the CIA to run a brothel for the R&R activities of U.S. soldiers on leave in Singapore.
e5bf3894bc5a04e0efffd05422016483.tagline: "People make love for so many crazy reasons-- why shouldn't money be one of them?" - The Gospel According To Saint Jack

e5d36a2690f3b3aa862770b946f3ced6.overview: A sheltered young high society woman joins the US Army on a whim and finds herself in a more difficult situation than she ever expected.
e5d36a2690f3b3aa862770b946f3ced6.tagline: The Army was no laughing matter until Judy Benjamin joined it.

e5d7f6b268e171a25b7624bab77e2089.overview: Aisha, a Senegalese immigrant who takes a job as a nanny for a wealthy white family in New York City, finds herself consumed by unsettling visions and a growing rage.
e5d7f6b268e171a25b7624bab77e2089.tagline: We're haunted by what we leave behind.

e5ead2f09b5ebcda774f5b4e3f85cff6.overview: In a picture-perfect seaside town, an insurance salesman begins to realize that his entire existence may be staged and observed by a vast unseen audience as part of a long-running real-time reality TV show.
